none: PAS LANCUM-5EB846: Roman copper alloy nummus of Constantine II
contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ BEATA TRANQVILLITAS VOTIS XX PTR

A copper alloy nummus of Constantine II dating to the period AD 321 to 323 (Reece Period 16). Reverse type BEATA TRANQVILLITAS VOTIS XX PTR. Cf RIC 7 (Trier), 419. The diameter is 20mm, and the weight is 2.1g. Obverse inscription CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C; reverse inscription BEATA TRANQVILLITAS VOTIS XX PTR
